name: Poster Enricher
description:
Automatically adds poster artwork to every EPG programme so your media server's guide never shows blank cards.

Uses a 6-tier lookup chain: TMDB → TVmaze → TVDB → Fanart.tv → OMDB → channel logo composite. First match wins.

With zero API keys you still get TVmaze (free, no key needed) plus channel-logo composites — no card is ever blank. Adding a free TMDB key typically covers ~50% of programmes.

Channel logos that fall back to the final tier are placed on a properly-sized dark poster canvas (not stretched). These composites can be served locally, through your Plex server, or uploaded to ImgBB's free CDN so they work on all clients including mobile and remote.

The plugin auto-runs after each EPG refresh and supports a configurable timer interval. All lookups are cached to minimise API calls.
author: ckegels
_fields_note: Settings are defined dynamically in plugin.py via the Plugin.fields attribute (single source of truth). This static array is intentionally empty so it can't drift.

actions.label: Enrich EPG Now
actions.description: Queues a background job that walks every programme and injects poster artwork.

actions.label: Cancel Run
actions.description: Stops an in-progress enrichment between batches.

actions.label: View Stats
actions.description: Shows per-source hit rates, duration, and timestamp from the last run.

actions.label: View Unmatched
actions.description: Lists programme titles that fell through to the channel-logo fallback.

actions.label: Clear Cache
actions.description: Wipes the local lookup cache so the next run re-queries every source.
